page: Microsoft Azure NC32ads_A10_v4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCADSA10v4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an AMD processor, paired with 400.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.5 GB per vCPU.

For hardware acceleration, the server is equipped with a single NVIDIA A10 GPU providing 22 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is comprised of a 2949 GB SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Azure Premium Storage for expanded disk performance.

Given the combination of dedicated AMD processing cores, a high-capacity local SSD, and an NVIDIA A10 GPU, this configuration represents a dense hardware profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory alongside GPU acceleration without needing multi-GPU setups. Suitable workloads include GPU-accelerated databases, deep learning inference, data analytics, and memory-intensive visualization tasks.
